hook.name: SoulHook
hook.description: A pump.fun-style bonding-curve hook for Uniswap V4. ETH buys mint SOUL tokens along a constant-product curve; sells burn them. The hook intercepts all swaps via beforeSwap (requiring an encoded swapper address in hookData), handles token minting and burning directly, and graduates to a locked Uniswap V3 LP position once the bonding curve fills.
